label: preparing
what: A jubilee surprise gathering in the great hall on day 1 at 18:00, with lantern lighting and a target of 200 loaves, and the mayor escorted under a lighting-inspection appointment. Likely initially undisclosed, but explicitly disclosed to the mayor by the secretary on day 0 at 17:36; it did not remain secret. Freight, builder and innkeeper coordinated logistics; baker knowingly supplied bread, though knowledge of the surprise is not established. Secretary knowingly assisted logistics after disclosure, not proven secrecy. Neighbour and watchman are not established as knowing helpers.
